In Monaco there is a casino where cards are dealt, dice are rolled, and every sort of vice is served alongside the champagne. Somewhere in the room, someone has just hit the blackjack that he was praying for. At the next table, another has lost everything on the river. By any metric, the room looks lawless and depraved. But do not be misled: a prince presides over the air, and everyone in the establishment worships him. He decides the next card, the next roll, who goes bust and who goes home rich. There is no bargaining or pleading with him; he does not even notice that you are praying. **In the Casino de Monte-Carlo, that god is Chance** and he doesn't care about you.
